| [Multi-document transaction rollback](04-checkout/transaction-rollback.md) | Inside a transaction the charger's stock is decremented, then the phone turns out to be sold out. Aborting rolls the charger back: all-or-nothing (ACID atomicity). | 7. Characteristics: ACID transactions | 2026-09-27 18:30 |
